brief.industry: Proposed visual storytelling and creative content brand; actual business category unverified
brief.business_idea: Develop a distinctive creative world exploring gothic romance, dark fairytales, mystery, beauty and transformation across imagery, short films, editorial stories, social media and an immersive website. This is proposed positioning, not a verified business model. Source reference: https://www.instagram.com/blackfeatherceremony/ ; full grid and bio were not accessible. Search snippets only suggested thematic direction.
brief.offer_summary: Full-service agency brief: positioning, audience definition, brand narrative, messaging hierarchy, original tagline options, logo concepts, primary and secondary wordmarks, compact mark, color system, typography hierarchy, image direction, graphic elements, motion principles, social templates, responsive website layouts and comprehensive style guide. Launch kit: 12 feed graphics, 4 carousels with complete copy, 8 story templates, 6 reel covers, 3 short-video concepts with shot lists and sound direction, profile graphics, website hero assets and email signup graphic. Supply captions, calls to action, alt text and reusable generation prompts. Provide editable source and optimized exports only where implemented; label specifications versus rendered files. Commissions, collaborations, prints and digital editions are proposed future offers, not confirmed products.
brief.target_audience: Proposed primary: adults interested in gothic romance, dark fantasy, atmospheric art, cinematic storytelling, alternative aesthetics and emotionally expressive visual culture. Motivations: imaginative escape, distinctive expression, beauty with tension and stories worth revisiting. Proposed secondary: musicians, independent filmmakers, publishers, fashion creatives and cultural brands seeking compatible collaborations. Demographics and commercial demand are unverified.
brief.product_type: brand website / editorial portfolio / creative content platform
brief.tone: Intimate, atmospheric, evocative and specific; poetic headlines with clear factual supporting copy
brief.market: International, online-first, English-speaking; headquarters and local service area unconfirmed
brief.workflow_idea: INTAKE actual bio, representative posts, captions, logos, artwork, offerings and approved assets; use screenshots when inaccessible. AUDIT source-linked themes, composition, colors, type, language and audience responses. STRATEGY define positioning, motivations, promise, personality, messaging and visitor actions; propose overlooked opportunities with rationale and approval state. CONCEPT three directions scored editorially for recognition, resonance, legibility, originality and channel utility; obtain approval before extension. IDENTITY original concepts preserving approved identifiers; define palette roles, type, spacing, grid, imagery, motifs and motion. CONTENT three variants per major description: concise, evocative, conversion-focused; distinguish poetic fiction from facts. WEBSITE responsive Home, Work/Stories, project details, About, Contact; cinematic hero, positioning, featured stories, introduction and next action; include mobile navigation, empty/error states, keyboard access, contrast, reduced motion and optimized media. Journal/signup conditional on content/consent plans; Shop only with confirmed products/fulfillment. SOCIAL four pillars: narrative worlds, artwork details, process and community conversation; 30-day calendar with purpose, format, caption, visual direction and CTA; compose per format. GUIDE foundations, logo clear space/minimum sizes/misuse, colors, type, grids, photography/illustration, voice/examples, social, web, accessibility, motion, export and naming. REVIEW facts, consistency, originality, spelling, licensing, accessibility and output quality independently. PACKAGE under Black-Feather-Ceremony/{Strategy,Identity,Guidelines,Website,Social,Motion,Copy,Exports}, editable masters plus manifest of purpose, dimensions, format, version, approval. APPROVAL before publishing, scheduling, commerce or live account modification.
differentiators: beauty with tension rather than generic Halloween imagery
brand_style_notes: PROPOSED direction, not verified existing identity
expressive serif headlines and readable supporting type
palette subject to artwork review and contrast tests
slow purposeful motion with reduced-motion alternatives
constraints: No verified Instagram grid or bio inspection; do not claim otherwise
No invented founder story, location, products, services, testimonials, prices, credentials or heritage
Do not imply spiritual services from the name
No excessive occult symbolism without source support
No generic Halloween graphics or illegible decorative body type
No need for literal feathers in every composition
Use licensed fonts and approved imagery
Digital RGB/sRGB masters; printer-specific CMYK only when requested; no invented Pantone matches
Memorability and resonance scores are editorial judgments, not measured audience outcomes
List missing inputs and proposed additions with rationale; do not silently promote assumptions into facts
Stop at human review; no auto-approval, publication, paid media or commerce activation
Report unsupported deliverables explicitly; a prompt or specification is not a finished graphic, video or website
